badge-resistor-code.name: Color Code Badge
badge-resistor-code.blurb: Can decode a resistor's stripes on sight.

trinket-clipboard.name: The Judge's Clipboard
trinket-clipboard.blurb: Got a prototype through judging day and knew exactly why it did what it did.

trinket-band-silver.name: Silver Band
trinket-band-silver.blurb: Finished the Color Challenge. Ten percent tolerance — close enough to build with.

trinket-band-gold.name: Gold Band
trinket-band-gold.blurb: Scored 60+ on the Color Challenge. Five percent tolerance, like most resistors in the kit.

trinket-band-brown.name: Brown Band
trinket-band-brown.blurb: Scored 85+ on the Color Challenge. One percent tolerance — the precise ones.

trinket-band-violet.name: Violet Band
trinket-band-violet.blurb: Scored 105+ on the Color Challenge. A tenth of a percent. Almost nobody reads bands that fast.

trinket-golden-capacitor.name: Golden Capacitor
trinket-golden-capacitor.blurb: A button’s metal contacts bounce when you press them, flickering on and off in a few thousandths of a second. A capacitor is like a little bucket of charge that takes time to fill back up, so those quick flickers can’t change its level. The board sees one smooth press.
